assets.tang-background.svg: Generate ONE self-contained inline SVG illustration. Subject: a flat, minimal, two-color decorative silhouette scene evoking the Tang dynasty (唐朝) for an educational reading-competition app aimed at grade 4-9 students in Taiwan. Visual motif: a city watchtower / beacon tower silhouette on the right, a camel caravan silhouette on a winding road on the left, suggesting the Silk Road. Style: flat vector silhouette art (like a paper-cut / shadow puppet), NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, no gradient-heavy skyline, 2-3 colors max (warm amber/terracotta tones, transparent background). ViewBox 0 0 400 160 (wide banner), meant to sit as a subtle, low-opacity background decoration behind a purple gradient card — light line weight, avoid heavy solid fills. Hard constraints: only tags {svg,g,path,circle,ellipse,rect,line,polygon,polyline,text,tspan,defs,linearGradient,radialGradient,stop}; only a fixed attribute allow-list; no <script>/<image>/<foreignObject>/<use>, no event handlers, no javascript:, no url(...); under 4000 chars.
assets.song-background.svg: Generate ONE self-contained inline SVG illustration. Subject: a flat, minimal, two-color decorative silhouette scene evoking the Song dynasty (宋朝) for the same app. Visual motif: a row of hanging lanterns (燈籠) silhouettes along the top, a multi-story pavilion/teahouse rooftop silhouette (瓦子/茶樓) on the right. Style: flat vector silhouette art (paper-cut style), warm red/vermillion tones, transparent background. ViewBox 0 0 400 160, subtle low-opacity background decoration, light line weight. Same hard constraints as tang-background.svg.
